deviations.description: Re-grep for any other file in the source store that shows a hand-typed phase-commit stage_paths array, and migrate or cross-reference each one found.
deviations.reason: The grep found ~14 other per-extension implementation agents (lean, nix, rust, typst, books, latex, web, python, z3, cslib, epidemiology, founder, nvim, and the web skill) carrying the identical hand-typed stage_paths shape, each with its own Phase Checkpoint Protocol copied from the same template general-implementation-agent.md's two sites were migrated from. Full migration of all of them is a separately-scoped follow-up far beyond this phase's 1-hour budget and this task's WHY/ACCEPTANCE sections, which name only general-implementation-agent.md's two sites. Chose the lighter-weight 'cross-reference' option the task text explicitly allows: documented the finding in git-staging-scope.md's new 'Scope of the git-commit-phase.sh migration' passage so it is discoverable for a future task, rather than silently migrating zero of them with no record.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — cross-referenced rather than migrated; see git-staging-scope.md's new "Scope of the git-commit-phase.sh migration" note and the plan deviation entry)*
